```{bash}
04-pacbio/tools/pbmm2 index ../data/GCF_016432855.1_SaNama_1.0_genomic.fa ../data/GCF_016432855.1_SaNama_1.0_genomic.fa.pacbio.mmi
```

```{bash}
samtools view \
-H \
../data/pacbio-reads/m84082_250614_081210_s3.hifi_reads.bam \
| grep '^@RG'
```


```{bash}
04-pacbio/tools/pbmm2 align \
../data/GCF_016432855.1_SaNama_1.0_genomic.fa \
../data/pacbio-reads/m84082_250614_081210_s3.hifi_reads.bam \
../analyses/05-pacbio-align/m84082_preset.bam \
--preset CCS --sort --num-threads 48

```




```{bash}
head 
```
